name: George Batten
bio: Secretary to the Viceroy of India, and the man Mabel Hatch married in 1874 when she was about eighteen - the marriage that gave her the surname she is known by. They had one daughter, the painter and film-maker Lady Cara Harris. He was still living when his wife met Radclyffe Hall in 1907; Hall and Mabel Batten set up house together in Cadogan Square only after his death.
